title: fix(rest): a door whose environment's security service cannot be resolved refuses rather than proceeds
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:REST 层所有读取环境 security 服务的地方都走同一个解析器,按服务注册表自带的「从未注册」标记分两种情况:没注册 ⇒ 视为该部署没有权限体系,各门照旧(`/security` 各门照旧答 501);注册了但解析不出来 ⇒ 答 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,什么都不提供。
- 为什么改:加固规则——一个门所在环境的 security 服务解析不出来时,这个门拒绝,而不是继续(ADR-0106 D6 第三档、ADR-0049:解析失败永远不能读成放行)。
- 风险与回滚:只在「security 已注册但构造失败,或在 security 这一步取不到环境内核」的故障态下生效:导出、导入模板、对象 schema 读取、`/security` 各门答 503;记录页照常返回,只有 explain 与 fieldAccess 两个分片各自带 503。没装 plugin-security、或单内核没有 security 服务的部署行为不变(已钉测试)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` 的 `resolveSecurityService`(核心分类,catch 分支 4 行);② `packages/rest/src/security-routes.ts`(两个族改走同一解析器,各自 catch 增加 503 分支);③ `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` 的 `answerExplain`(解析挪进每个操作自己的 try)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/rest-environment-scoped-providers.test.ts src/rest-export-permission-gate.test.ts src/security-explain-envelope.test.ts src/security-suggested-bindings-envelope.test.ts src/rest-server-suggested-bindings-status.test.ts`,预期 5 个文件、225 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Rule: a door whose environment's security service cannot be resolved refuses rather than proceeds.**

`RestServer.resolveSecurityService` keeps the two answers the `security` slot can give apart, by the service registry's own "never registered" brand (`isServiceNotRegisteredError`), never by message text:

- **Not registered** answers `undefined`: no provider is wired, the environment's kernel registers no `security` service, or the branded rejection reaches the resolver. The deployment has no permission posture (ADR-0106 D6 tier 1), and every caller keeps its documented degradation for that case, the `/security` doors' `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` included.
- **Registered but unresolvable** (a registered factory that throws, or the environment's kernel failing to be acquired at the security step) raises the existing `AuthzStoreUnavailableError('security', cause)`, answered as `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (ADR-0106 D6 tier 3; ADR-0049). No error code, envelope key or public export is added.

The doors listed in the table below ask this one resolver. The access-explanation family and the suggested-binding family in `security-routes.ts` hand their reads to it through their route hosts instead of carrying their own; each family's `catch` answers the outage as the data door's own `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (`mapDataError`, message withheld as every 5xx there is) through the family's one emitter. The record page resolves the explain part's security service once, inside each operation's own `try` and after the caller check (the order `/security/explain` asks in), so the part carries the refusal and the page still answers. This is the same classification the anonymous form doors' tenancy read already makes. The environment-scoped provider in `rest-api-plugin.ts` is unchanged.

Measured on the hosted multi-environment shape (the first six rows and the explain door and suggested bindings), in each security family's envelope test (the delegable scope, confirm, dismiss and reopen), and by a one-off probe on `b7ef72106` for the effective-access door (`503` / `501` / healthy `200`), which no test drives:

| Door | Security service registered but unresolvable | Not registered |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET …/data/:object/export` | `503`, no row read, nothing written | serves, as before |
| `GET …/data/:object/export?template=true`, its gate | `503`, no template | serves, as before |
| the same template, its column projection | `503`, no template | projection `none`, as before |
| `GET …/meta/object/:name` (object-schema mask, on by default) | `503`, no schema | unmasked, as before |
| `GET …/data/:object/:id/field-access` | `503` | `501`, as before |
| `POST …/data/:object/:id/page`, `explain` and `fieldAccess` parts | each part carries the `503`; the page answers `200` with the record | each part `501`, as before |
| `GET`/`POST …/security/explain`, `…/security/my-delegable-scope`, `…/security/users/:id/effective-access` | `503` (nested envelope) | `501`, as before |
| `…/security/suggested-bindings`, its confirm, dismiss and reopen | `503` (nested envelope) | `501`, as before |

Docblocks of the resolver, the export gate, the import-template gate, the object masker, both security families and the record page's explain part state the rule.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/rest-environment-scoped-providers.test.ts`, two top-level describes on the existing hosted rig (real `ObjectKernel`s behind one REST plugin), each case on both the scoped and the hostname mount:

- *a door whose environment's security service cannot be resolved refuses rather than proceeds*: for a security slot registered as a throwing factory, and for an acquisition rejecting at the security step, the export, the import template's gate and the object-schema mask each refuse with `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and serve nothing; the template's column projection refuses when its own security step cannot be resolved after the gate answered; the record page still answers, its explain and field-access parts each carrying the `503`; the access explanation and the suggested bindings refuse with `503`. Controls in the same describe: a healthy service (export `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED`, template `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, projection `writable`, schema masked, explain part and both `/security` doors answered by the environment's service); an environment with no security service (every door serves, projection `none`, schema unmasked, the explain part and both `/security` doors `501`); an environment no acquisition reaches (still refused before any door serves); and the resolver still answering `undefined` where nothing is registered.
- *a single kernel with no security service keeps serving every door, as before*.

`packages/rest/src/rest-export-permission-gate.test.ts`: a wired provider that rejects answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with nothing read; a provider rejecting with the registry's own "never registered" rejection (from a real kernel, asserted branded) is allowed, exactly as no security service at all.

`packages/rest/src/security-explain-envelope.test.ts` and `packages/rest/src/security-suggested-bindings-envelope.test.ts`, one describe each, in the family's nested envelope: a security provider that rejects answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` on every route; a caller context whose authorization store cannot be read answers the same `503`, and the service is never asked; the registry's "never registered" rejection keeps the `501`.

## Acceptance notes

- The two security families' outage arm answers any `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` reaching their `catch`, so a caller context whose authorization store cannot be read answers these doors `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Same rule, same family emitters; pinned in both envelope test files.
- The data-action call sites inherit the classification through their route host with no edit (the table above).

## Verification

Final head `b7ef72106` (`origin/main` merged in at `f90cb94fb` and `b5a46e2aa`; the rest dependency closure rebuilt after the first). Each reading names the head it was taken on.

<details>
<summary>Ablations of the server's resolver (round 1, on 40711ac7d)</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hit as declared, blob changed, restore proven each time (blob equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty). The subject resolves through relative `src` imports, so no build sits between mutation and run.

- The classification reverted on disk: 15 red, 129 green of 144 (the 14 refusal legs and the unit case for a rejecting provider); every control green.
- The "never registered" branch removed: 1 red, 143 green of 144 (the unit case for the registry's rejection). A first attempt was refused by the tool before any run (its replacement was a substring of its anchor); it is not counted.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Ablations of round 2</summary>

- On `a77a0c67a`, the explain part's resolution put back before the loop, outside the per-operation try: 4 red, 143 green of 147, exactly the record-page legs for the two unresolvable environments on both mounts. Restored.
- On `a77a0c67a`, both security families' resolvers made to swallow the rejection: 4 red, 143 green of 147, exactly the access-explanation and suggested-binding legs for the two unresolvable environments on both mounts. Restored.
- On `cbc8eeaf8`, both families' outage arms disabled: 4 red, 58 green of 62, exactly the four outage pins in the two envelope files. Restored. A first attempt is void and not counted: its replacement inverted the explain helper's guard instead of disabling it, so four unrelated `500`-arm cases went red too.
- `b7ef72106` after these adds only a type annotation to the two families' resolvers (nothing emitted differently).

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` on `b7ef72106`: 394 files passed, 7538 tests passed, 332 skipped; lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- The five files of the two-minute check on `b7ef72106`: 5 files, 225 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (tsc plus the test-layer typecheck) on `b7ef72106`: `command-exit 0`; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all four edited test files, and the debt ledger holds 0 files.
- `test:repo` (the package's `repo` vitest project) is not run locally: this diff edits none of its files; CI's Test Core runs it.
